title: ThinkComposer JSON Interchange
description: Schema for ThinkComposer.JsonInterchange formatVersion 1. Use this schema to validate full-state exports/merges and GPT-authored patch-operation documents. Native .tcom remains the authoritative ThinkComposer file format; this JSON format is an editable interchange layer.

format.description: Fixed format discriminator. GPT responses must preserve this exact value.

formatVersion.description: Schema/version discriminator for this interchange format.

exportedAtUtc.description: UTC timestamp of the export. Optional for patch-only GPT responses.

application.description: Producing application. Optional for patch-only GPT responses.

targetContext.description: Exporter-provided identity/version context for the composition and embedded domain used to generate this JSON.

requires.description: Optional GPT-authored compatibility requirements. Import compares these values to the active composition/domain before apply according to importOptions policies.

visualStrategy.description: Optional large-import visual materialization strategy. Use this when generated JSON should create the semantic model without forcing ThinkComposer to create, refresh, auto-fit, or route every visual immediately.

ideas.description: Concept nodes. Relationships are stored separately in the relationships array.

relationships.description: Relationship nodes and their origin/target role links.

views.description: View and lightweight layout information. Visual styling and binary data are intentionally omitted.

operations.description: Patch-style edits. Preferred shape for GPT responses when editing an existing project. Do not include deletes unless explicitly requested.

warnings.description: Exporter/importer warnings. GPTs may include warnings only when they intentionally skip requested edits.

techName.description: ThinkComposer technical name. It is not guaranteed to be globally unique; use id/GlobalId for matching whenever possible.

editableText.description: Editable text. Preserve line breaks exactly when round-tripping summaries or rich text converted to plain text.

autoPlaceNewItems.description: When true or omitted by the importer, created concepts and relationships are placed in a suitable view when no explicit placement is supplied.

autoFitPlacedConcepts.description: When true or omitted by the importer, newly created or newly placed concept visuals are resized to fit their visible text using the same ConceptAutoFitService as Edit > Appearance > Fit Concept Width to Text.

autoRoutePlacedLinks.description: When true or omitted by the importer, relationship visuals/connectors created, placed, or repaired by import are routed with the same obstacle-avoidance service as Edit > Appearance > Route Links with Obstacle Avoidance.

useActiveCompositionAsContainer.description: Opt-in fixture/GPT convenience. When true, root-level create/place operations with missing, placeholder-like, unresolved test composition container references, or the canonical sentinel containerTechName Active_Composition_Root may use the active composition as the container. Default false. Intended for regression fixtures and GPT patches targeting the active root composition, not nested imports.

treatMissingFullStateItemsAsCreates.description: Opt-in full-state import convenience. When true, missing top-level ideas[] and relationships[] with enough safe create data can be created in the active composition. Default false, because full-state sections are normally interpreted as updates/merge references. Patch-style operations remain preferred for GPT-authored creates.

relationshipDefinitionFallbackTechName.description: Optional draft-import fallback relationship definition. If a create relationship operation resolves endpoints but the requested relationship definition rejects their concept definitions, the importer may retry this fallback definition unless the operation has strictDefinition=true. Disabled when omitted.

detailFallbackMode.description: Controls unsupported GPT-authored details when no native detail designator can be applied. Default skip warns and preserves the idea. appendToTechSpec or appendToDescription appends a delimited text representation to the idea.

domainCompatibilityPolicy.description: How import handles requires.domain / targetContext.domain mismatches. Defaults to warn. requireSignature compares the deterministic embedded-domain compatibility signature.

compositionVersionPolicy.description: How import handles requires.composition / targetContext.composition mismatches. Defaults to warn.

strictRelationshipCompatibility.description: When true, relationship create operations are preflighted against native relationship-definition endpoint compatibility before apply.

abortOnRelationshipCompatibilityFailure.description: When true with strictRelationshipCompatibility, any relationship compatibility failure blocks the import before opening the command variation.

strictDetailsCompatibility.description: When true, unsupported details or missing detail designators are considered strict compatibility failures.

abortOnDetailCompatibilityFailure.description: When true with strictDetailsCompatibility, detail compatibility failures block the import before apply.

layoutMode.description: Controls automatic placement for created items without explicit coordinates. Default is gridNearViewport, which keeps imported batches near the visible/normal content cluster and ignores extreme outliers.

preventSelfRecursiveCompositeViews.description: When true or omitted, the importer will not place a concept inside its own composite view or place a relationship visual in a composite view when an endpoint is that view's owner.

repairRecursiveVisuals.description: When true or omitted, import scans for previously imported self-recursive visual representations and removes only the invalid visuals, preserving concepts and relationships.

mode.description: Controls visual materialization. modelOnly creates semantic ideas/relationships/details/TechSpec and suppresses visuals. overviewAndModel creates the full model plus a capped overview. optimizedFullVisual allows visuals but defaults expensive auto-fit/route/refresh work to deferred. exactFullVisual preserves legacy exact placement behavior.

largeModelThresholds.description: Thresholds used by mode=auto to choose overviewAndModel for large generated documents.

fullModelVisuals.description: For overviewAndModel, false caps visual materialization to overview limits; true allows full visual materialization while still honoring defer flags.

overviewView.description: When true, overview visual placement prefers overviewViewTechName if that view already exists, otherwise the importer falls back to the active/root view. JSON view creation is still deferred.

overviewViewTechName.description: Preferred existing overview view techName, such as Overview_View. If not found, active/root view fallback is used.

maxOverviewConcepts.description: Maximum concept visuals to materialize in overviewAndModel when fullModelVisuals=false.

maxOverviewRelationships.description: Maximum relationship visuals to materialize in overviewAndModel when fullModelVisuals=false.

groupBy.description: Relationship definition techNames that describe overview grouping intent. Current importer records this intent for diagnostics; full grouping layouts remain manual/command-driven.

deferRouting.description: When true, import does not queue auto-route work even if importOptions.autoRoutePlacedLinks or operation autoRoute would normally route created links.

deferAutoFit.description: When true, import does not run concept auto-fit during apply even if auto-fit options are enabled.

deferViewRefresh.description: When true, import skips immediate affected-view ShowAll/FitContentIntoView/reveal work after apply. This is important for very large model imports.

compatibilitySignature.description: Deterministic embedded-domain compatibility signature. Used only for domain context.

techSpec.description: Technical specification text attached to the composition. It is imported as text only and never executed.

delete.description: Reserved. Do not use for composition deletion in GPT responses.

techSpec.description: Technical specification text attached to the embedded domain summary. It is imported as text only and never executed.

compatibilitySignature.description: Deterministic compatibility signature for the embedded domain summary exported with the composition.

techSpec.description: Technical specification text attached to the exported definition summary. It is imported as text only and never executed.

originIdeaTechNames.description: Origin endpoints by techName. Prefer ids when available.

targetIdeaTechNames.description: Target endpoints by techName. Prefer ids when available.

entity.description: Tolerated alias for kind on GPT-authored full-state-style documents. Prefer kind.

isNew.description: When true, a missing top-level idea/relationship may be treated as a create even if it has an id. Prefer patch operations for GPT-created content.

techSpec.description: Technical specification text attached to the concept or relationship. Omission preserves the existing value; an explicit empty string clears it.

containerId.description: Id of the containing Composition, Concept, or Relationship.

containerTechName.description: Container technical name. Use Active_Composition_Root with importOptions.useActiveCompositionAsContainer=true for root-level GPT patches intended to import into the active composition.

originIdeaTechNames.description: Origin endpoints by techName. Prefer ids when available.

targetIdeaTechNames.description: Target endpoints by techName. Prefer ids when available.

delete.description: Only set true when explicitly requesting deletion. Omission must not be interpreted as deletion.

roleType.description: Relationship role side. Current exporter emits Origin and Target.

designatorId.description: Native detail designator id alias used by exports.

designatorTechName.description: Native detail designator techName alias. GPT-authored patches may also use techName.

designatorName.description: Native detail designator display name alias. GPT-authored patches may also use name.

kind.description: Editable detail kind. Prefer Text for GPT-authored content unless the export contains a more specific kind.

content.description: Alias for text accepted by the importer for GPT-authored details.

value.description: Alias for text accepted by the importer for GPT-authored details.

targetPropertyTechName.description: Optional known idea field to update, such as Name, Summary, Description, or TechSpec.

rows.description: Table detail rows, when exported as editable data.

records.description: Alias for table detail rows accepted by the importer.

metadata.description: Safe non-binary metadata for unsupported details.

op.description: Requested import action. Use update for text edits, create for new model items, place for diagram visibility, and delete only when explicitly requested.

containerTechName.description: Container technical name. Use Active_Composition_Root with importOptions.useActiveCompositionAsContainer=true for root-level GPT patches intended to import into the active composition.

fallbackDefinitionTechName.description: Optional per-operation fallback relationship definition for draft imports. Used only when the requested relationship definition exists but rejects the resolved endpoint concept definitions, and strictDefinition is not true.

strictDefinition.description: When true on a relationship create operation, disables relationshipDefinitionFallbackTechName and requires the requested relationship definition to accept the endpoints.

viewTechName.description: Placement view technical name. Prefer an exported view techName when known. Active_View, Main_View, or Active_Composition_Root_View may fall back to the active/root view when safe.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for the operation.

x.description: Top-left X coordinate for explicit visual placement.

y.description: Top-left Y coordinate for explicit visual placement.

width.description: Optional symbol width for concept placement.

height.description: Optional symbol height for concept placement.

autoPlace.description: For create operations, overrides importOptions.autoPlaceNewItems for this item.

autoFit.description: Overrides importOptions.autoFitPlacedConcepts for this operation. Set true to auto-fit an updated existing concept even when it is not newly placed; set false to keep a newly placed concept's supplied/default width.

autoRoute.description: Overrides importOptions.autoRoutePlacedLinks for this operation. Set true to route an existing visible relationship touched by update/place; set false to keep a newly placed or repaired relationship's current connector route.

originIdeaIds.description: Relationship origin endpoints at operation top level. Top-level fields are preferred over set.* fields.

originIdeaTechNames.description: Relationship origin endpoints by techName at operation top level. Prefer ids when available.

targetIdeaIds.description: Relationship target endpoints at operation top level. Top-level fields are preferred over set.* fields.

targetIdeaTechNames.description: Relationship target endpoints by techName at operation top level. Prefer ids when available.

links.description: Relationship role links at operation top level. Top-level links are preferred over set.links.

details.description: Optional details to apply to a created concept/relationship. Unsupported detail structures warn without skipping the concept or relationship.

markers.description: Optional marker assignments to apply to a created concept/relationship.

set.description: Editable fields to apply for create/update operations.

techSpec.description: Technical specification text to apply to entities that expose TechSpec. Omission preserves the existing value; an explicit empty string clears it.

fallbackDefinitionTechName.description: Accepted inside set for GPT-authored relationship create patches; top-level fallbackDefinitionTechName is preferred.

strictDefinition.description: Accepted inside set for GPT-authored relationship create patches; top-level strictDefinition is preferred.

containerTechName.description: Accepted inside set for GPT-authored patches; top-level containerTechName is preferred. Active_Composition_Root is the canonical active-root sentinel when importOptions.useActiveCompositionAsContainer=true.

originIdeaIds.description: Accepted inside set for GPT-authored relationship create/update patches; top-level originIdeaIds is preferred.

originIdeaTechNames.description: Accepted inside set for GPT-authored relationship create/update patches; top-level originIdeaTechNames is preferred.

targetIdeaIds.description: Accepted inside set for GPT-authored relationship create/update patches; top-level targetIdeaIds is preferred.

targetIdeaTechNames.description: Accepted inside set for GPT-authored relationship create/update patches; top-level targetIdeaTechNames is preferred.

links.description: Accepted inside set for GPT-authored relationship create/update patches; top-level links is preferred.

viewTechName.description: Accepted inside set for GPT-authored patches; top-level viewTechName is preferred. Active_View, Main_View, or Active_Composition_Root_View may fall back to the active/root view when safe.

autoFit.description: Accepted inside set for GPT-authored patches, but top-level autoFit is preferred.

autoRoute.description: Accepted inside set for GPT-authored patches, but top-level autoRoute is preferred.
